correction_explanation: The previous alias-expanded intersection of 66 was invalid because set expansion adds BOTH identifiers (e.g., CVE-X and GHSA-Y) from each equivalence class to both expanded sets. When both IDs appear in both expanded sets, the intersection double-counts the same vulnerability. The correct metric uses equivalence-class canonicalization: each vulnerability counts ONCE as a (canonical_class, package, version) tuple.
